up: Return all activity records from assay CHEMBL1614087. For each record, provide the canonical SMILES of the compound and the exact activity value, standard units, and standard relation from the activities table. Include the activity type as well.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_relation, a.standard_type FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614087' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_relation IS NOT NULL
